title.zh: Magic Eden scare puts 3,832 NFTs in whitehat protective custody
title.en: Magic Eden scare puts 3,832 NFTs in whitehat protective custody

current_state.zh: 针对 Magic Eden 相关授权的安全事件中，Magic Eden 警告其已关闭的 EVM 市场（2024 年 2 月至 10 月）上架的 NFT 曾暴露于 Limit Break Payment Processor V2 漏洞；白帽行动已保护 23,155 枚 NFT，价值超过 570 万美元，但 660 WETH 未能追回；攻击者盗走指定 NFT；Limit Break 已暂停存在相同缺陷的 V3，而 V2 无法暂停；持有人仍被要求撤销以太坊、Polygon 和 Base 上的易受攻击授权。
current_state.en: In the Magic Eden-related approvals security incident, Magic Eden warned that NFTs listed on its closed EVM marketplace (February–October 2024) were exposed to a Limit Break Payment Processor V2 exploit; a whitehat operation rescued 23,155 NFTs worth more than $5.7 million, but 660 WETH was not recovered; the attacker stole specified NFTs; Limit Break paused the similarly flawed V3 while V2 could not be paused; holders are still urged to revoke vulnerable approvals on Ethereum, Polygon, and Base.

updates.title_zh: Legacy Magic Eden Approvals Exploited as White Hats Rescue NFTs
updates.title_en: Legacy Magic Eden Approvals Exploited as White Hats Rescue NFTs
updates.what_changed_zh: 白帽行动已保护 23,155 枚 NFT，价值超过 570 万美元，较此前报告的 3,832 枚大幅增加；事件被描述为遗留的 Magic Eden 授权被利用，持有人仍需撤销易受攻击的 NFT 和代币授权。
updates.what_changed_en: White hats secured 23,155 NFTs worth more than $5.7 million, up from the 3,832 previously reported; the incident is described as exploits of legacy Magic Eden approvals, and holders still need to revoke vulnerable NFT and token approvals.

updates.current_state_en: In the Magic Eden-related approvals security incident, a whitehat operation has secured 23,155 NFTs worth more than $5.7 million; holders are still required to revoke vulnerable NFT and token approvals.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Exploits of legacy Magic Eden NFT/token approvals led white hats to secure 23,155 NFTs worth more than $5.7 million, with holders still required to revoke vulnerable approvals.

updates.title_zh: Magic Eden Warns Old Ethereum NFT Listings Are Exposed to Payment Processor Exploit
updates.title_en: Magic Eden Warns Old Ethereum NFT Listings Are Exposed to Payment Processor Exploit
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道披露漏洞源于 Limit Break 的 Payment Processor V2，Magic Eden 于 2024 年 2 月至 10 月关闭的 EVM 市场上架的 NFT 受影响；除已救援的 23,155 枚 NFT 外，另有 660 WETH 未能追回；攻击者盗走 10 枚 Meebits、50 枚 Otherdeeds、10 枚 World of Women 和 235 枚 Desperate ApeWives；Limit Break 已暂停存在相同缺陷的 V3，但 V2 无法暂停；用户被建议在以太坊、Polygon 和 Base 上撤销合约授权。
updates.what_changed_en: The new report reveals the exploit stemmed from Limit Break's Payment Processor V2 and affected NFTs listed on Magic Eden's EVM marketplace between roughly February and October 2024; beyond the 23,155 NFTs rescued, 660 WETH was not recovered; the attacker stole 10 Meebits, 50 Otherdeeds, 10 World of Women, and 235 Desperate ApeWives; Limit Break paused the similarly flawed V3, but V2 could not be paused; users are advised to revoke contract approvals on Ethereum, Polygon, and Base.
updates.current_state_zh: 针对 Magic Eden 相关授权的安全事件中，Magic Eden 警告其已关闭的 EVM 市场（2024 年 2 月至 10 月）上架的 NFT 曾暴露于 Limit Break Payment Processor V2 漏洞；白帽行动已保护 23,155 枚 NFT，价值超过 570 万美元，但 660 WETH 未能追回；攻击者盗走指定 NFT；Limit Break 已暂停存在相同缺陷的 V3，而 V2 无法暂停；持有人仍被要求撤销以太坊、Polygon 和 Base 上的易受攻击授权。
updates.current_state_en: In the Magic Eden-related approvals security incident, Magic Eden warned that NFTs listed on its closed EVM marketplace (February–October 2024) were exposed to a Limit Break Payment Processor V2 exploit; a whitehat operation rescued 23,155 NFTs worth more than $5.7 million, but 660 WETH was not recovered; the attacker stole specified NFTs; Limit Break paused the similarly flawed V3 while V2 could not be paused; holders are still urged to revoke vulnerable approvals on Ethereum, Polygon, and Base.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Magic Eden warned that NFTs listed on its closed EVM marketplace between roughly February and October 2024 are exposed to an exploit in Limit Break's Payment Processor V2, after a whitehat operation rescued 23,155 NFTs worth more than $5.7 million while 660 WETH could not be recovered, urging users to revoke contract approvals.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Magic Eden warned that NFTs listed on its closed EVM marketplace between roughly February and October 2024 are exposed to an exploit in Limit Break's Payment Processor V2, after a whitehat operation rescued 23,155 NFTs worth more than $5.7 million while 660 WETH could not be recovered, urging users to revoke contract approvals.
updates.background_zh: Payment Processor V2 是由 Limit Break 开发和维护的 NFT 交易协议，Magic Eden 于 2024 年采用其在 EVM 上结算交易，当年 10 月停止使用，并在 2026 年初彻底关闭其 EVM 市场。该公司于 2 月放弃对以太坊和比特币的支持，转而聚焦 Solana 及其加密赌场 Dicey，随后又关停了其多链钱包。此次披露的前一天，不明黑客从 Bitget 交易所盗走了超过 3.8 亿美元的以太坊及其他加密资产。
updates.background_en: Magic Eden adopted Payment Processor V2, an NFT trading protocol built and maintained by Limit Break, to settle trades on EVM in 2024, stopped using it that October and shut its EVM marketplace entirely in early 2026. The company dropped Ethereum and Bitcoin support in February to focus on Solana and its crypto casino Dicey, and later wound down its multichain wallet. The disclosure lands one day after unknown hackers took more than $380 million in Ethereum and other crypto assets from the Bitget exchange.
updates.market_impact_zh: 风险通过链上残留授权传导：凡是在以太坊、Polygon 或 Base 上向 Payment Processor V2 授予过 setApprovalForAll 权限的钱包，在撤销前仍存在资产被转移的托管风险，而未追回的 660 枚 WETH 则构成已实现损失。此次事件也在 Bitget 被盗之后，进一步加重了市场对安全问题的情绪压力。
updates.market_impact_en: The exposure runs through lingering on-chain approvals: wallets that granted setApprovalForAll to Payment Processor V2 on Ethereum, Polygon or Base still carry custody risk until those permissions are revoked, and the 660 WETH that could not be recovered represents a realized loss. The incident also adds to near-term security sentiment pressure following the Bitget hack.
